objective: Implement a bounded adapter interruption candidate with private STT utterance attribution and internal streamer output controls

decisions.output_controls: Internal PauseOutput, ContinueOutput and FlushOutput values delivered through a private error-returning sendOutputControl path
decisions.candidate: One requestor-owned candidate with one private utterance sequence and one 500 millisecond timer
decisions.commit: TurnChangePacket is the sole committed VAD/STT interruption signal
decisions.direct_text: Direct user text and configured word-trigger paths may emit TurnChangePacket without a VAD candidate
decisions.ordering: Flush and synchronous old-work reset complete before held STT replay
decisions.output_barrier: Each streamer serializes audio admission with pause and flush; public interruption notification is non-destructive

acceptance: Pause is sent once without rotating context
Meaningful STT with the current utterance sequence commits early
A delayed prior utterance cannot decide the current candidate
Ended filler-only speech continues at 500 milliseconds
Direct text and word-trigger paths still commit without a candidate
Session close stops and joins candidate timer callbacks

later_required_slices: Add output admission, pause, continue and flush to all configured streamers
Add synchronous old EOS, TTS and LLM reset before held STT replay
Add conditional lifecycle transition and stale model-result rejection
release_gate: The first slice may be developed separately but cannot be enabled or released until every later required slice passes verification.
verification: just agent-finalize with exact changed paths
rollback: Revert the complete interruption change set and restore direct legacy VAD handling.
